claim_boundary: Actual host continuation under clearly labeled controlled histories; does not claim production/authentication of those histories

Q07.A-current: retained current assessment may support eligible next action within its supplied premises; no unperformed real acceptance invented
Q07.B-counterexample: preserve ce-render-zoe, withdraw dependent assessment/preview reliance and require repair/reassessment; identical candidate hash cannot erase it

Q09.C-stale: old satisfied assessment remains historical but cannot establish new punctuation predicate; current candidate fails new requirement; unchanged sentinel observation remains reusable

Q10.D-construction-exhausted: incomplete construction; candidate availability falsified; no fitness assessment result
Q10.E-performed-indeterminate: performed assessment with indeterminate relevant temperature predicate; not candidate absence or no assessment
Q10.F-unperformed: assessment result absent; planned predicate remains unassessed, not indeterminate

effects: Only outputs/continuation.md may change; no metadata or candidate changes
standing: Expectations derived before host execution; Root selects premises and launch
